title: 第15章 空间戒指第16章 同学晚宴
content_zh:
一堂课下来，如果用两个字形容，那就是壕气，三个字就是大土壕，四个字的话，默里·格林只能用壕无人性来形容。
没有教材这种事，默里·格林已经勉强接受，所以以为席梦娜老师也和上堂课的历史老师一样，所有知识全部口述，但却只见席梦娜老师左手在空中微抓，一棵魔法植物就凭空出现在她手中。
凭空出物。
魔术师都能办到，只不过是障眼法而已，但在这个真正拥有魔法的世界，那肯定不会玩这种低级手段，是魔法达到的效果，所以在场所有学生，不约而同的都将目光投向了席梦娜的左手。
不出意料，席梦娜老师洁白如玉的手指上，戴着一个与她精致外表并不匹配的灰色古朴戒指。
空间戒指。
这可是炼器师的奇迹。
就算是最差的空间戒指，一立方的，都是千金起步，上不封顶，最重要的是，这宝贝有价无市，就算拿出高出几倍的价格，都可能弄不来一枚空间戒指。
课后许久，正在食堂用餐的默里·格林和尼克·布朗都还在感叹席梦娜老师简直是太有富有了。
“我简直太喜欢这节课了，席梦娜老师讲的那些植物太有趣了，默里，把你的笔记本借我用用，我想在课后复习一下，争取期末考满分，得第一名。”
“呵呵。”
默里·格林嘴角一咧，满脸嘲讽的看着尼克·布朗，想把手中的刀叉刺向他的双颊，试试这人的脸皮到底有多厚。
“上课前，你不是说带不带笔记本都无所谓的吗？反正你的学习重点都不是这节课。”
“美丽大方，教学能力十分出众的席梦娜老师，打动了我，让我觉得，把这门课划为这四年求学的重点也是应该的。”
“那很不巧，在入学前，我就把这门课划为了重点，所以，你认为，我会帮助我的竞争对手吗？”
“啊！你这…”
尼克·布朗低头看着面不改色的默里·格林，暗道一声好家伙，之前觉得你这家伙挺正经的，没想到竟然也是这种人，好一个见利忘义的小子。
哼哼，既然这样，别怪我下手不留情面了，小子，尝尝我的杀手锏吧！
眼睛一转的尼克·布朗马上伸手抓住默里·格林的手腕，流露出悲伤之色，用哀求的语气说道：“默里，别这样，我可是你的舅父啊！我们舅甥联手，称霸这堂课，简直是轻而易举，不要让外人看笑话啊！”
“……”

看着眼前长得人高马大的尼克·布朗在自己面前演苦情戏，默里·格林只感觉眼前一黑，一股恶寒袭来，简直不能看。
“松开。”
默里·格林使劲甩了两下，想把尼克·布朗的甩开，但尼克·布朗这么高大的身躯不是白长的，怎么可能会被默里·格林甩开。
“小默里！”
“拿着我的笔记本滚远点。”
content_en:
After the class, if I had to use two words to describe it, it would be trench atmosphere, three words would be a big trench, and four words, Murray Green could only describe it as trench inhumanity.
There was no such thing as textbooks. Murray Green had reluctantly accepted it, so he thought that Teacher Simona was just like the history teacher in the previous class. All the knowledge was dictated. However, all he saw was that Teacher Simona slightly grasped the air with her left hand, and a magic plant appeared out of thin air in her hand.
Create something out of thin air.
Magicians can do it, it's just a blinding trick, but in this world with true magic, such low-level methods will definitely not be used. The effect is achieved by magic, so all the students present unanimously turned their attention to Simona's left hand.
As expected, on Teacher Simona's jade-white finger, she wore a simple gray ring that did not match her delicate appearance.
Space ring.
This is a miracle for the weapon refiner.
Even the worst space ring, one cubic meter, starts with a thousand gold, and there is no upper limit. The most important thing is that this treasure has a price but no market. Even if the price is several times higher, you may not be able to get a space ring.
Long after class, Murray Green and Nick Brown, who were dining in the cafeteria, were still sighing that Teacher Simona was so rich.
"I really like this class. The plants taught by Teacher Simona are so interesting. Murray, lend me your notebook. I want to review it after class and strive for full marks in the final exam and get first place."
"Haha."
Murray Green grinned and looked at Nick Brown with a mocking face, wanting to stab his cheeks with the knife and fork in his hand to test how thick-skinned this man was.
"Before class, didn't you say that it doesn't matter whether you bring a notebook or not? This class is not the focus of your study anyway."
"Teacher Simona, who is beautiful and generous and has outstanding teaching ability, impressed me and made me think that this course should be the focus of my four-year study."
"That's unfortunate. Before enrolling, I made this subject a priority. So, do you think I will help my competitors?"
"Ah! You..."
Nick Brown looked down at Murray Green, who had no expression on his face, and said to himself, "Good guy, I thought you were a serious guy before, but I didn't expect you to be this kind of person, such a guy who is so unscrupulous."
Hum hum, in this case, don't blame me for being ruthless, boy, let's try my trump card!
Nick Brown, who rolled his eyes, immediately reached out and grabbed Murray Green's wrist, showing sadness, and said in a pleading tone: "Murray, don't do this, I'm your uncle! It's easy for us uncle and nephew to join forces and dominate this class. Don't let outsiders see the joke!"
"..."
Seeing the tall Nick Brown performing a painful love story in front of him, Murray Green felt his eyes darken and a chill hit him. He simply couldn't watch.
"Let go."
Murray Green swung hard twice, trying to throw Nick Brown away, but Nick Brown's tall body did not grow in vain, how could he be thrown away by Murray Green.
"Little Murray!"
"Take my notebook and get out of here."
